services.name: School Programs
services.desc: The Museum at Liberty Hall, New Jersey’s premier center for history, is proud to offer a series of standards-based educational programs for students from pre-kindergarten through university levels. Programs provide students a unique opportunity to engage, experience, and explore American history. Liberty Hall’s extensive collection of artifacts and documents, along with experienced, enthusiastic museum educators, bring history to life at a location of pivotal moments in New Jersey and the nation’s history.
